description: A dark purple petunia with a green center sits in a reflective white vase. The vase rests on a white and gray surface, casting a shadow on the righthand side of the canvas. Behind the surface is a background of soft, cloudy, pink and white brushstrokes.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
